**Promise checked (caller suggestion held).** A startup baseline keeps an existing question quiet — a session already needing attention at SessionAlerts startup must not alert until a genuine re-entry after working. Matches the story key example and slice 1.

**Fault (caller suggestion revised).** Site: `dashboard/server/sessionAlerts.ts` poll loop around the former `if (before === undefined) continue;` gate. Removing only that `continue` leaves `before` undefined on the first poll, so `before.get(id)` would throw rather than alert. Consequential revision to achieve the suggested wrong behavior (“first poll alerts”): bypass the gate and use `before?.get(id)` so an empty last reading on the first poll produces a notification. Fixtures and assertions left intact.
